The structure of Mg6Cu2W2O16 (Mg3CuWO8) is tetragonal, space group I4_1/a (No. 143), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and W each in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Mg adopts a 10-vertex coordination polyhedron. Corner-sharing occurs between CuO6 and WO6 octahedra, and between Mg and both CuO6 and WO6 polyhedra, with additional corner, edge, and face contacts observed. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
